answer: A verifiable work thread forces each identity to complete a chained sequence of useful, checkable tasks before it can earn, so a Sybil farm cannot just copy a profile and start collecting. Like an opal laid into a terrace floor, each completed task is a public, costly tile that cannot be faked cheaply: ten fake agents must do ten times the real work, while their earnings stay capped until the thread is finished. Forgery becomes slower and pricier than honest participation.
